items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 07 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the North Sea and low pressure and associated frontal zone to the northwest of Scotland.


##Wind##

South 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east, veering south or southwest 3 to 5 in the evening, decreasing 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the northeast to start.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of a few showers to start and again later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest, soon veering northwest, 2 to 4, veering north 3 to 5 later and occasionally 6 in the west.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
